title: AFTERIMAGE//PULSE (identity proof)
description: DaemonV12 Sound Lab 03: 26 bars of melodic garage-bass, E major, 136 BPM. THRONE//VOLT, Living Bass, Impossible Voice, HEAVEN//MASS, Mechanical Orchestra, Timbre Lab; V12 Signature and GLASSHOUSE drums.

tracks.description: V12 IRON PULSE body + GLASSHOUSE bass-punch knock (small-speaker attack).
V12 TITANIUM CRACK +1 st + GLASSHOUSE chrome clap (C#6 ring); laid back 5-8 ms; ghosts.
GLASSHOUSE pixel hat 16ths, V12 ghost tick and open circuit; swung.
Timbre Lab hollow log (rims, knuckles), hand skin (fills, talking drum, the heartbeat), escapement clock.
The afterimage: Mechanical Orchestra bar, a dotted eighth behind the hook.
Living Bass below 120 Hz: the phase-locked sine sub, mono, ducked under every kick.
Living Bass above 120 Hz: the talking body, saturated for small speakers.
Impossible Voice: the hook as chops in the glitch passage; the cry carried into the afterimage.
THRONE//VOLT: the hook in the groove, an octave up at the payoff.
THRONE//VOLT pluck: the opening statement, and the body under the payoff lead.
THRONE//VOLT pad: the chord bed, breathing in the hook rhythm (dips on each pickup).
HEAVEN//MASS basses (with octavists on the C major bloom) and tenors.
HEAVEN//MASS altos and sopranos: the hook at half speed, the G that lifts to G#, the payoff's long notes.
The shared rack room (wet only) of the lead, keys, voice and percussion scores.
